view_split.rule: sort ascending SHA256(seed + decimal COLMAP image ID); first 22 decision, next 33 train, remaining 11 appearance_eval

pilot.rule: From all fixed XY units with max(mvs_count,als_count)>=30, choose lexicographically ordered evenly spaced integer indices before any new image measurement; retain all cells and all source layers in the common payload.

reference_role: EVALUATION_ONLY; never used in candidate construction, registration, decision, parameter choice, or reconstruction
sample_origin: Previously selected P2 development prism based on historical MVS-ALS relation diagnostics; no independent test claim
